Description: th, San Francisco Giant Jim Ray Hart tied a modern Major League record with six runs batted in during one inning with all coming in the fifth. The "bay area brawler" slammed a three run home run and three run triple and eventually hit for the cycle en route to a 13-0 victory over the Atlanta Braves.

, Jim Ray Hart hit for the cycle to become the 13th Giants player with a cycle. However, did you know that on this same date he also drove in six runs during the same inning - a feat not accomplished since 1911?

, A.J. Burnett of the Florida Marlins no-hit the San Diego Padres, yet walked nine batters setting a new National League record. The record he broke belonged to Dock Ellis of the Pittsburgh Pirates who walked eight in his no-hitter tossed on June 12, 1970 versus (yet again) the San Diego Padres.
